message.content: I've noticed some darker skin over my finger joints and knees. I haven't had fever, night sweats or cough. I don't remember the other symptoms you listed being mentioned, and I don't know why the scan was done. Five years ago I was in hospital for a spot on my chest scan, but I wasn't told it was TB and got no treatment. No cancer or inherited illnesses in the family that I know of, and I haven't taken steroids.
